'''Nettani''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Rek]] in the [[Guter Wade system]], located in the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Nettani had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and was covered in toxic [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Guter Wade system]], except [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
